text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I lost, didn't I... That's too 
bad...
choice_data_list: Sorry... I couldn't lead you to victory.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't think taking on this race was in 
vain at all... It was unfortunate, but 
there's no reason to be sad.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I still have the next race ahead 
of me...! Besides, I don't have the time 
to sit around lamenting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Losing is truly frustrating. And yet, 
being able to run and compete against 
someone is such a wonderful, enjoyable 
thing...!

still got plenty of room to grow! ♪
